t: Specialist, high performance, thick white lithium grease formula for long lasting protection against rust and corrosion. Will not drip or run. Ideal for metal-to-metal applications to ensure tools and equipment keep moving smoothly, without friction or seizing. For use on load-bearing metal connections such as towbars, gear and brake mechanisms and CV joints. Ideal for maintaining gardening tools. For use outdoors in all weathers and temperatures. Water and heat-resistant. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows for upright or upside-down application.
